name: 12 AWG Silicone-Insulated Stranded Copper Power Bus Cable

source.source: ASTM B258 standard 12 AWG copper resistance + typical silicone UAV hookup wire ampacity/mass band
source.notes: DC resistance at 20 C follows ASTM B258 copper cross-section; installed ampacity (60 A) and jacket mass/m depend on airflow/bundling and are UNVERIFIED_ESTIMATE until measured on the exact harness.

cross_section_m2.source: ASTM B258 nominal 12 AWG area (3.31 mm^2)

resistance_ohm_per_m.source: ASTM B258 annealed copper nominal 5.21 mOhm/m at 20 C

mass_kg_per_m.source: Typical 12 AWG silicone-jacketed UAV cable mass estimate
mass_kg_per_m.notes: Jacket thickness varies by vendor; UNVERIFIED_ESTIMATE until weighed.

max_continuous_current_a.source: Assumed free-air silicone wire ampacity rating
max_continuous_current_a.notes: Thermal ampacity depends on bundling and airflow; UNVERIFIED_ESTIMATE.

max_voltage_v.source: Typical 600 V silicone jacket insulation rating
